title: A Strong MoE Is All You Need for Process Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.29498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. translated_title: 一个强大的MoE就是过程监督所需要的一切
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRM）为多步推理提供了细粒度的监督，然而获取可靠的过程标签仍然是一个核心瓶颈。现有方法通常依赖人工标注、基于 rollout 的估计或辅助验证。在本工作中，我们探索了一种由混合专家模型天然暴露出的不同过程监督来源：专家路由。我们证明，简单的路由统计量能够提供一种内在的过程置信度信号，其表现可与传统的输出 logit 置信度相媲美。基于这一观察，我们通过结合整体路由质量、注意力头路由质量以及步内路由变化来构建路由置信度，并提出了 RoCo-Rethink，它能够识别置信度最低的推理步骤，并选择性地重新生成后续轨迹。我们进一步提出了 RoCo-PRM，它利用一个强大的 MoE 模型，通过路由置信度自动为推理轨迹进行标注……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心创新在于发现MoE模型的专家路由统计天然蕴含过程置信度信号，据此提出RoCo-Rethink与RoCo-PRM，利用路由置信度自动标注推理轨迹并选择性重生成低置信步骤，从而无需人工标注即可实现可靠的过程监督。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that MoE expert routing statistics naturally provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal, and based on this, proposes RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories and selectively regenerate low-confidence steps, enabling reliable process supervision without human annotation.
